import sys,subprocess,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
pin="4e11d60b6f0ec50aa391c68ed39a0df138adf8cf"
git=lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(["git","--no-optional-locks",*args],cwd=root)
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip()==pin and not git("status","--porcelain")
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
from workflow_delivery_tree import Tree
from workflow_delivery_io import canonical_json
tree=Tree(root,revision=pin)
contract=tree.json("specs/workflow_delivery/rollout.contract.json")
manifest=tree.manifest(contract["input_roots"])
assert len(manifest)==161 and manifest==Tree(root).manifest(contract["input_roots"])
modules=[r for r in manifest if r["path"].endswith(".py")]
for row in modules: compile((root/row["path"]).read_bytes(),row["path"],"exec")
executable=Path(sys.executable).resolve()
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip()==pin and not git("status","--porcelain")
print(json.dumps({"source_commit":pin,"input_manifest_sha256":hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(manifest)).hexdigest(),"toolchain":sys.version,"modules_compiled":len(modules),"source_clean":True,"artifacts_written":False,"interpreter":{"path":str(executable),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},"validator_source_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"scripts/check_workflow_delivery.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
